    • Academic Departments

    Morgan Zintec College is organised into four academic departments, each headed by a Head of Department and comprising multiple sections led by Lecturers-in-Charge.

    View Research Portal Contact Us
    Our Academic Structure

    Academic Departments

    Each department is headed by a Head of Department and comprises multiple sections led by Lecturers-in-Charge.

    📖

    Department of Humanities

    HOD: Mr B. Ziso

    One of the largest departments at the college, comprising Languages, Social Sciences, and Contemporary subjects. Responsible for developing student teachers' soft skills, cultural competence and 21st century competencies.

    Sections:

    ChiShonaIsiNdebeleEnglishFAREMEHeritage-Social StudiesHealth & Life SkillsNASS
    View Department Sections Staff Members
    🔢

    Maths & Sciences

    HOD: [To be updated]

    Covers Mathematics, Science and related STEM areas preparing student teachers to effectively teach at the primary school level. Focuses on inquiry-based learning, practical skills and problem-solving pedagogy.

    Sections:

    Mathematics PSBMathematics Main SubjectScience PSBScience Main SubjectEnvironmental Science
    View Department Sections Staff Members
    🔬

    Research & Innovation

    HOD: [To be updated]

    Drives the college's research agenda in alignment with Education 5.0. Oversees Theory of Education, Professional Foundations, Teaching Practice, Distance Education and the In-Service Programme.

    Sections:

    Theory of EducationProfessional StudiesTeaching PracticeDistance EducationIn-Service Programme
    View Department Sections Staff Members
    🧒

    Early Childhood Development (ECD)

    HOD: [To be updated]

    Dedicated to the training of early childhood educators through the Infant Course of the Diploma in Education and the ECD Short Course. Covers developmental psychology, ECD methodology and community-based programming.

    Sections:

    ECD MethodologyDevelopmental PsychologyECD Short CourseInfant Teaching PracticeCreative Arts in ECD
    View Department Sections Staff Members
